description: Standard greenhouse gas emission factors for personal carbon footprint calculations. Values reflect realistic Indian/regional baselines (CEA, MoEFCC, IPCC).

electricity.note: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) India national grid carbon intensity baseline (approx. 0.71-0.75 kg CO2e/kWh).

lpg.note: IPCC & Ministry of Petroleum standard emission factor for liquefied petroleum gas combustion.

food.note: Estimates based on lifecycle analysis (Poore & Nemecek, Science) tailored for monthly household consumption patterns.

waste.note: Based on municipal solid waste landfill methane emission defaults adjusted for diverted recycling and organic composting.

water.note: Represents municipal water treatment and pumping energy carbon intensity (approx. 0.35 kg CO2e per 1,000 liters).
